name: Hiyoko no Kimochi
source:
Main character Fumiya is a boy in the girls school. He is only interested in football until the day he encounters a lonely girl. He starts to worry about her. One day he encounters mysterious creatures dressed up as angel and devil. They promise to help Fumiya get around girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公文也是一所女子学校里的男生。在遇见一名孤独女孩之前，他一直只对足球感兴趣。此后，他开始为她担心。一天，他遇见了分别装扮成天使和恶魔的神秘生物。它们答应帮助文也学会与女孩们相处。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
